candidate_relations.label: Pathologic myopia with chorioretinal atrophy
candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record confirms high/pathologic myopia with chorioretinal atrophy, so this candidate captures the broader disease context and a component finding. However, the benchmark reference specifically requires 'myopic macular pit' — a distinct focal lesion defined by scleral ectasia, obliterated choroid, and absence of overlying retina on EDI-OCT — which is not named in this candidate. The candidate is a parent entity missing the required specific subtype/lesion.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the underlying myopic disease and one of its features (chorioretinal atrophy) but does not specify the focal scleral ectasia/pit lesion that constitutes the myopic macular pit diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Myopic macular pit is a rare and specific entity; EDI-OCT findings (focal scleral ectasia, thinned sclera, obliterated choroid) are pathognomonic and clearly documented in the record.
